$comment: Advisories deliberately accepted for packages/app, checked by
.github/actions/npm-audit. Every entry expires: on that date the
audit job goes red and the exception has to be argued again, not
inherited. Deleting an entry whose advisory is fixed is also
required — a waiver matching nothing fails the job too.
Adding one is a deliberate act: state why the risk is acceptable
here, in the diff, where a reviewer sees it.

waivers.reason: No patched version exists: the advisory covers <=2.0.2 and 2.0.2 is the latest published release. Reached only through metro, the React Native bundler, which runs at build time over first-party assets and ships nothing into the app binary. The impact is a parser infinite loop on a malicious ICNS file, i.e. a build that hangs.
Same root cause and same reasoning as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr — JXL and HEIF parsers rather than ICNS. No patched version exists, and image-size is only reachable through the metro bundler at build time.
